## Context / Problem
Eighteen Python developer tools contain repeated, historical, or misleading comments/docstrings identified by the audit and revalidated on current `origin/main` at `91c31a4109ec34672aecac76f3ae081bf2e9a20a`. Eleven module docstrings feed `argparse`; their user-facing help may be shortened only while preserving flags, defaults, exits, and operational meaning.

## Approach
Edit only comments/docstrings and blank lines in declared files. Preserve executable AST structure. Keep behavior-bearing sanctions/directives exact and retain the minimum current rationale or user guidance each consumer needs.

## Scope
- `alert_dedup.py` — Preserve one open ticket per tag at a time, 24-hour per-lane marker cap, nanosecond coercion, and fail-soft reads.
- `amend_commit_message.py` — Preserve Change-Id carry/refusal, replacement of file-supplied IDs, ordered sign-offs, hooks, and staged changes.
- `backfill_caused_by.py` — Preserve conservative strict-majority blame, closed-source link writes, derived provenance, idempotency, and dry-run default.
- `backtest_bugfix_size.py` — Preserve pinned 113-commit/13-member corpus, production predicates, planning assertion, both modes, all-work metrics, offline boundary, and best-effort labels.
- `build_cloud_adf_corpus.py` — Preserve deterministic sampling/shards, size cap, scrubbing, vocabulary normalization, frozen-fixture rule, and downstream consumers.
- `build_dc_wiki_corpus.py` — Preserve deterministic stratification/caps, scrubbing, normalization, and frozen counts.
- `canary_bridge.py` — Preserve alert classes, consecutive-red handling, abort-if-empty, dedup/capping, provenance, and invocation-independent imports.
- `capture_jira_fixtures.py` — Preserve live opt-in/read-only capture, four production response shapes, layered scrubbing, recent-comment trimming without shape drift, outputs, and refresh cadence.
- `check_cli_json_js_safe.py` — Preserve scan roots, stdout-sink/nested-expression detection, `js_safe_dumps` exemption, reasoned sanctions, fail-closed behavior, and exits.
- `check_comment_hygiene.py` — Preserve Python comment/docstring coverage, trigger/acceptor regexes, sole structural exclusion, and stable-path versus ticket-alias distinction.
- `check_commit_message_wrap.py` — Preserve 50/72 defaults, trailers/tags, fenced/indented blocks, tables/comments, unbreakable tokens, and diagnostics.
- `check_complexity_baseline.py` — Preserve Ruff threshold source, exclusive buckets, stale-only pass, new/increased failure, update refusal, schema validation, and merge-base fail-closed behavior.
- `check_config_ownership.py` — Preserve composition-root, credential/provider boundaries, canonical environment readers, registry completeness, and actionable diagnostics.
- `check_config_reads.py` — Preserve receiver-aware AST resolution, bounded fixed point, marker semantics, and required ticket pointers.
- `check_criteria_vocabulary.py` — Preserve git-owned scope, fallback exclusions, fail-closed decoding, allowances, and escaped/capped diagnostics.
- `check_deploy_manifest.py` — Preserve Docker/Compose derivation, manifest union, reasoned/stale exclusion checks, and zero-derived-path liveness floor.
- `check_destructive_test_exec.py` — Preserve unsafe recursive-force/interpolated-target detection, injectable seam/preceding guard acceptance, and static-analysis boundary.
- `check_fcntl_import_guard.py` — Preserve module-scope guard rules, lazy-import exclusion, conditional handling, reasoned sanction, and accepted guarded example.

Consumers include Make/CI gates, canary and advisory workflows, runbooks, fixture tests, and CLI users. Preserve all `# noqa: E402`, `# noqa: BLE001`, `# pragma: no cover`, `# type: ignore[assignment]`, and `# raw-git-ok:` directives, plus documented `# js-safe-ok:` and `# fcntl-guard-ok:` syntax/examples. Do not claim corpus/fixture consumer tests directly execute their generators.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Python ASTs are unchanged after docstrings are removed; only comments/docstrings/blank lines differ.
- [ ] Every Scope constraint and consumer contract has a PASS row with concrete before/after citations in a leaf-linked session log authored by a reviewer who did not write the remediation.
- [ ] Every edited block has an independent `bloat-removal` PASS row; user-facing help remains complete and exact directives remain.
- [ ] Focused tool/gate/consumer tests, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and repository lint pass; no missing or FAIL semantic row remains.

## Verification
Run the recorded AST prose-only guard, focused suites, path-scoped diff check, and worktree-venv lint.
